purpose: Prevent diagnostic loops and force material forward progress through the already-frozen I6 postproduction sequence without changing Evergreen semantics or duplicating runtime state.

rules.text: Exactly one I6 mini-gate may be operationally active. The next mini-gate cannot open until the current mini-gate reaches its required mini-freeze or an exact HOLD dependency is recorded.
A review, green governance workflow, state reconfirmation, elapsed time or repeated diagnostic is not progress. Each mini-gate must produce its required material evidence and state transition.
A discriminant already executed may not be repeated unless source, artifact, configuration, permissions, dataset, snapshot, harness or another causal input relevant to that discriminant has changed.

Every execution cut resolves to PASS, FIX or HOLD. PASS requires proof. FIX requires a reproducible defect, isolated cause, bounded correction and causal regression. HOLD requires one exact blocking dependency.

Previously accepted PASS evidence remains reusable while its release identity and relevant causal inputs remain unchanged. A PASS capability is reopened only by reproducible causal regression or a governed lineage exception.
Each mini-gate uses one authoritative executor path. No one-shot branch, parallel methodology or replacement workflow is created to work around a failure inside the active gate.

Paula participates only where human action is materially required: visual/legal acceptance, an exact APPLY authorization, or a business conflict that cannot be adjudicated mechanically. No local/manual command is requested unless technically unavoidable.

Every authorized operational write follows diff -> authorization -> controlled apply -> before/after receipt -> readback/integrity. A partial failure never authorizes blind re-import or duplicate application.
Postproduction exit progress is measured only by frozen I6 mini-gates, not by hours, diagnostic rounds, commits or workflows executed.

forbiddenAsProgress: operational writes are zero without baseline evidence

notes: This lock is execution discipline only; the Evergreen V4 addendum remains the governing definition of I6.
CONTROL_PLANE.json remains the sole persistent runtime state authority.
I6_POSTSALIDA_PLAN_LOCK_20260914.json remains state-free and its frozen sequence is unchanged.
